Our Roofing Services

From a slipped tile to a full re-roof, plus the chimneys, roofline and brickwork around it, across Sevenoaks, Kent and South London. We also do exterior painting.

Roof RepairsWe inspect the roof to identify the cause of the problem before carrying out repairs.
Flat RoofingWe specialise in flat roof repairs and replacements using high-quality torch-on felt, GRP fibreglass and EPDM rubber roofing systems.
Roof ReplacementWe carry out complete roof replacements using high-quality tiles, slates, breathable membranes and treated timber battens.
Roof CleaningWe carry out professional roof cleaning by manually removing moss and debris using specialist roof scrapers, avoiding unnecessary pressure washing.
General BrickworkWe carry out general brickwork repairs, including repointing, replacing damaged or spalled bricks, chimney repairs and masonry maintenance.
GutteringWe repair or replace guttering and downpipes in high-quality uPVC, securely fitted and correctly aligned so rainwater actually drains away rather than overflowing or pooling at the joints..
Fascia and SoffitsWe replace damaged timber fascias with maintenance-free uPVC boards and fit ventilated soffits, so there's no more painting and the roof space can breathe..

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does a roof repair typically cost?

A normal repair runs from about £400 up to £2,500, depending on what the roof needs. If most of the roof is sound and only one area has failed, it sits at the lower end.

Do you offer free roof inspections and quotations?

Yes. We come and take a proper look at the roof and give you a free, no-obligation price.

How quickly can you attend to a leaking roof?

We aim to get to a leak quickly - several customers have had us out the same day a leak was reported.

How do I know whether my roof needs repairing or completely replacing?

Brittle tiles, worn felt underneath the tiles and ridges starting to deteriorate are the usual signs a roof needs replacing rather than repairing. We'll tell you honestly which one yours needs.

Do you offer guarantees on your roofing work?

Yes. Each job comes with its own individual warranty, as there are many factors to this. Ask us about the warranty for your job when we quote.

How long does a full roof replacement take?

From three days upwards, depending on the size of the roof. A full re-roof with Redland 49 tiles and a classic cement ridge has taken us a week.
